{"code": "note_finding('There are 48 duplicate patient_id values, meaning 48 patients were re-tested. This violates the one-row-per-patient assumption. Must deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq row per patient.')

data['patient_id'] = data['patient_id'].astype(str)

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
data_dedup = data.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

print(f'Deduplicated data shape: {data_dedup.shape}')
print(f'Patient count after dedup: {data_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Original patient count: {data["patient_id"].nunique()}')"}
